scope: Static concept review only; no playback or listening; no user approval of these new images.

reviews.method: Inspected all four states on contact sheets at 1500x1640 after 30 revisions.
observations: Removed recurring unrelated presenter in 30 concepts.
Typography, glass, paper, scale, signage, evidence and physical objects now carry distinct narratives.
Changed hero for light-revealed relief to the final readable state; early frames intentionally show light before the title.
Six-unit example depicts six objects consistently.
Gear diagrams, data encodings and premise logic remain illustrative and require editable reconstruction and subject review.
reviews.decision: Suitable as fictional static direction references; not proof of movement or final execution.

limitations: Contact-sheet inspection is not full-resolution proof of text, anatomy, physics or identity.
Some examples reuse similar fictional presenters; visual diversity is not uniform across the catalogue.
Reviewed concept directions are not audiovisual approvals; user approval is pending except the 36 pilots.
Magnetic-rod count and auxetic/rubber mechanics need reconstruction and verification, not scientific inference from these drawings.
Generated interfaces, medical copy, numbers and product claims require authorized sources and editable reconstruction before real production.
Browser rendering, touch interaction, canvas downloads and 375px inspection were unavailable in this session.
